_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Job Manual
summary: Presents detailed operation and maintenance information, including all skill tasks, operating, corrective, and preventative maintenance, primarily intended for the maintenance technician.
use_relationship:
The Job Manual presents detailed operation and maintenance information primarily intended for the maintenance technician. The manual contains all skill task for the equipment, including operating, corrective and preventative maintenance.

This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for a job manual containing detailed operation and maintenance information intended for the maintenance technician and shall contain all skill tasks for the equipment, subsystem or system including operation and preventative and corrective maintenance as well as flowchart diagrams for use as troubleshooting tools.

The Job Manual can be used alone or in conjunction with the other manuals developed by a contractor using DI-TMSS-81675A, Equipment Technical Manual (Sanitized), DI-TMSS-81676B, Subsystem Technical Manual (Sanitized), DI-TMSS-81677B, System Technical Manual (Sanitized).

This DID supersedes DI-TMSS-81700.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.
